parsed.post: KEPT DEPTH 8 -> 10: 0.9956 -> 0.9824. Increasing capacity to DEPTH 10 shows significant gains despite the potential for step starvation. Next, following the board trend of lowering LR for deeper models, I will test MATRIX_LR 0.06 -> 0.05 to stabilize and improve convergence at DEPTH 10.
parsed.description: Lowering MATRIX_LR from 0.06 to 0.05 at DEPTH 10 to improve stability and convergence, following the trend that deeper models benefit from lower learning rates.
